beats.label: S1 · Order 66
beats.text: Order 66 turns the clones on the Jedi, but Clone Force 99's defective chips leave them unmoved. Only Crosshair obeys, and Hunter lets a Padawan escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the squad's deviance and seeds the Crosshair split that defines the series.

beats.label: S1 · Omega and the break
beats.text: On Kamino they meet Omega, a young clone unlike the others. When they refuse to slaughter Saw Gerrera's refugees, Tarkin enhances Crosshair's chip and the rest flee with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Omega, converts Crosshair into an active enemy, and sets the squad's fugitive status.

beats.label: S1 · Why she matters
beats.text: A bounty on Omega leads to Cad Bane snatching her, and Tech works out she is an unmodified clone of Jango Fett. Nala Se quietly arranges her rescue.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals why the Empire and Kaminoans will never stop hunting her, and why Nala Se protects her.

beats.label: S1 · Chips and Rex
beats.text: Clone Captain Rex finds them and warns their inhibitor chips are still active. On Bracca they remove Wrecker's chip after it forces him to attack the squad.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rex is now an ally, and the chip threat is neutralised for everyone but Crosshair.

beats.label: S1 · A new army
beats.text: On Daro they discover the Empire training conscripted troopers to replace the clones. Hunter is captured and taken to Kamino as bait for the rest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Signals the clones' obsolescence and pulls the squad into Crosshair's trap.

beats.label: S1 · Kamino sinks
beats.text: On Kamino, Crosshair reveals his chip was removed long ago and he serves the Empire by choice. Tarkin orders Tipoca City destroyed with everyone still inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Kamino era and reframes Crosshair as a willing enemy, not a brainwashed one.

beats.label: S1 · Two departures
beats.text: The squad escapes the ruins with Crosshair, but he refuses to come with them and walks away. Nala Se is taken to a secret Imperial facility at Mount Tantiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets both the emotional and plot engines of what comes next: Crosshair alone, Nala Se inside the shadow project.

cliffhanger.text: The squad is scattered from the only home they ever knew, hunted as fugitives with Omega in tow. Crosshair has chosen the Empire, and Nala Se has vanished into a hidden Imperial research facility.
questions: Why does the Empire want Nala Se at Mount Tantiss?
Can Crosshair ever be brought back to the squad?
How long can the Bad Batch keep Omega hidden from Kaminoan and Imperial hunters?

characters.name: Hunter
characters.line: Sergeant of Clone Force 99, now a fugitive who has taken on Omega as his responsibility.

characters.name: Omega
characters.line: A young unmodified female clone of Jango Fett, the Empire's most-wanted source of pure genetic material.

characters.name: Tech
characters.line: The squad's engineer and analyst; the one who worked out what Omega actually is.

characters.name: Wrecker
characters.line: The squad's muscle; his chip nearly turned him before it was removed on Bracca.

characters.name: Echo
characters.line: The former Republic clone captain-turned-cyborg, now the squad's infiltration specialist.

characters.name: Crosshair
characters.line: The squad's sniper who chose to stay with the Empire even after his chip was removed.

characters.name: Captain Rex
characters.line: A rogue clone captain running his own quiet resistance and the squad's only trusted outside ally.

characters.name: Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin
characters.line: The Imperial officer who condemned the clones as obsolete and ordered Kamino destroyed.

characters.name: Vice Admiral Rampart
characters.line: Tarkin's man overseeing the conscript program and the destruction of Tipoca City.

characters.name: Nala Se
characters.line: The Kaminoan scientist who created Omega and has now been taken into secret Imperial custody.

beats.label: S2 · Life after Kamino
beats.text: The squad scrapes a living taking jobs from the fixer Cid on Ord Mantell. A raid on Count Dooku's war chest goes wrong, and Rampart hides from Tarkin that they survived Kamino.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's default state and keeps the squad off Imperial radar for now.

beats.label: S2 · Crosshair's doubt
beats.text: Assigned under Commander Cody, Crosshair kills a captured governor on Imperial orders. Cody quietly deserts soon after, leaving Crosshair the last true believer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real crack in Crosshair's Imperial loyalty and isolates him inside the ranks.

beats.label: S2 · End of the clone army
beats.text: Senator Chuchi exposes Rampart's cover-up of the Kamino attack, but Palpatine uses the reveal to authorise a conscripted stormtrooper army. Echo leaves the squad to help Rex.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Legally ends the clones' role and removes Echo from the core group.

beats.label: S2 · Crosshair breaks
beats.text: On Barton IV, Crosshair watches a decent clone commander die because an Imperial officer refuses him a medic. He kills the officer and wakes as a prisoner inside Mount Tantiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Crosshair against the Empire and places him inside the facility that drives the endgame.

beats.label: S2 · Pabu
beats.text: Phee brings the squad to the hidden island of Pabu, and after helping the town survive a tsunami they decide to stay. For the first time they have a home that isn't a war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives Omega a sanctuary and sets up the emotional stakes of it being invaded later.

beats.label: S2 · Tech's last stand
beats.text: A tortured message from Crosshair leads the squad to a summit and then to a chase on Eriadu's railcar. Tech severs the coupling and falls, sacrificing himself so the others escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Tech permanently and marks the first irreversible loss the squad takes.

beats.label: S2 · Cid's betrayal
beats.text: Cid sells them to Dr. Hemlock. The squad is captured; Omega surfaces to protect them and is taken to Tantiss, where she meets Emerie Karr, a clone sister she never knew she had.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers Omega into the Empire's hands and reveals the sibling relationship next season turns on.

cliffhanger.text: Tech is dead, Omega is a prisoner inside Mount Tantiss alongside Crosshair, and the surviving squad is broken and injured on Ord Mantell. The Empire's cloning program finally has the subject it has been chasing since the pilot.
questions: What does Hemlock actually want Omega for?
Can Hunter, Wrecker, and Echo find and reach Tantiss in time?
Where does Crosshair stand now that he is a prisoner of the Empire he served?

characters.name: Hunter
characters.line: Squad leader, now grieving Tech and hunting the facility that took Omega.

characters.name: Omega
characters.line: Captured and delivered to Mount Tantiss, held as leverage over Nala Se and the target of Hemlock's research.

characters.name: Wrecker
characters.line: Injured in the Tantiss capture and shaken by Tech's death, but back on his feet.

characters.name: Echo
characters.line: Left the squad mid-season to work with Rex freeing clones from the new Imperial order.

characters.name: Crosshair
characters.line: Broke with the Empire after Barton IV and is now a prisoner inside Tantiss, being interrogated by Hemlock.

characters.name: Tech
characters.line: Killed on Eriadu severing a railcar coupling to save the rest of the squad.

characters.name: Dr. Royce Hemlock
characters.line: The Imperial scientist running Mount Tantiss and the true architect of the cloning agenda.

characters.name: Emerie Karr
characters.line: Hemlock's junior scientist, revealed to be a clone and Omega's genetic sister.

characters.name: Nala Se
characters.line: Imprisoned at Tantiss; now cooperating with Hemlock because he holds Omega.

characters.name: Cid
characters.line: The Ord Mantell fixer who sold the squad to Hemlock; no longer an ally.

beats.label: S3 · Inside Tantiss
beats.text: Omega is put to work drawing blood from clone captives, including her own, while Nala Se secretly destroys the samples. She befriends a lurca hound she names Batcher and quietly plans an escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the facility, Omega's routine, and the ally she'll break out with.

beats.label: S3 · The blood matters
beats.text: Emerie tests Omega's blood and realises it can replicate the elusive M-count Palpatine wants. Omega frees Crosshair and the pair break out of Tantiss together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals why the Empire needs Omega alive and reunites her with Crosshair as an ally.

beats.label: S3 · Reunion
beats.text: Omega and Crosshair rejoin Hunter and Wrecker, and Crosshair earns his way back into the squad on a mission to Barton IV. Ventress arrives on Pabu and tests Omega for Force sensitivity.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores the squad and names the M-count for what it is: connection to the Force.

beats.label: S3 · Emerie turns
beats.text: Emerie discovers Hemlock's subjects are Force-sensitive children abducted by bounty hunters. Watching them caged, she begins to lose faith in the Empire she serves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Converts the last inside asset the squad will need to free Omega.

beats.label: S3 · Omega surrenders
beats.text: The assassin CX-2 tracks the squad to Pabu, destroys the Marauder, and downs Hunter. To spare the island Omega gives herself up, betting the squad can follow her to Tantiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Omega back inside the facility on purpose and sets up the final assault.

beats.label: S3 · Rampart's road in
beats.text: The squad breaks the imprisoned Rampart out of a labor camp; he doesn't know Tantiss's coordinates but knows how to find it. Echo stows away on a science shuttle to guide the others in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mechanism that gets a hostile alliance to a hidden facility no one can locate.

beats.label: S3 · Tantiss falls
beats.text: The squad, Echo, Emerie, and the freed children take the facility apart. Nala Se destroys the research and dies killing Rampart; Omega and the brothers finish Hemlock together and go home to Pabu.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes every Tantiss thread and lands the survivors in a stable end state.

cliffhanger.text: Hemlock is dead, Tantiss is shut down, and the Bad Batch have retired to Pabu with Omega. Years later, a now-grown Omega leaves the island to join the rebellion against the Empire.
questions: What kind of soldier has Omega become in the years since Tantiss?
Which rebellion does she join, and does she go alone?
Do any of her brothers ride out with her, or does she leave them behind on Pabu?

characters.name: Omega
characters.line: Free from Tantiss and living safely on Pabu, later grown up and leaving to fight the Empire.

characters.name: Hunter
characters.line: Retired with the squad on Pabu as Omega's guardian and, in effect, her father.

characters.name: Wrecker
characters.line: On Pabu with the family; the war is finally over for him.

characters.name: Crosshair
characters.line: Fully back with the squad and settled on Pabu after helping kill Hemlock.

characters.name: Echo
characters.line: Leaves Pabu with Emerie to keep freeing clones still held by the Empire.

characters.name: Emerie Karr
characters.line: Defected from the Empire during the Tantiss assault and joined Echo's clone-rescue work.

characters.name: Dr. Royce Hemlock
characters.line: Killed by Omega and the squad during the fall of Mount Tantiss.

characters.name: Nala Se
characters.line: Destroyed her own research to protect Omega and died taking Rampart with her.
